title: Docs + release:next
summary: README + CHECKLIST docs, tool count bump, release:next.
description:
Document the new checklist workflow and status history cards; bump versions and publish a next prerelease.

CURRENT STATE:
- README.md documents `Task.statusLog` for tasks only; no mention of phase/feature statusLog or the card stepper. Documents the MCP tool list (currently 35 tools) — will grow by 1 (planner-task-checklist-toggle). Documents checklist only as a task-complete enforcement note.
- CHECKLIST.md tracks per-session work.
- Release flow: `pnpm release:next` bumps the prerelease counter and pushes; publish.yml publishes with the `next` dist-tag.
- plugins:sync / plugins:check must stay green (planner-skill.md.in changes re-generate the derived SKILL.md).

WORK:
1. README.md: 
   - MCP tools: add `planner-task-checklist-toggle`; update count 35 → 36.
   - Add a short "Task checklist" subsection near the task workflow: agents put implementation steps in `checklist` (planner-task-add/update), tick them with `planner-task-checklist-toggle` (accepts C{n}/id/title), task_complete enforces all checked. Items are numbered C1/C2… per task.
   - Status history: note that feature/phase/task detail pages show a chronological StatusCardStepper built from each entity's `statusLog`.
2. CHECKLIST.md: add a "F009 — Checklist exposure + status history cards" section tracking P001-P004.
3. AGENTS.md: optionally add a one-line rule under §2 (Lifecycle) or a new bullet: "Use the per-task checklist (planner-task-checklist-toggle, C{n}) for implementation steps; do not write DONE in step titles or put steps in description." (Keep minimal — don't bloat AGENTS.md.)
4. pnpm check + pnpm plugins:check green.
5. pnpm release:next — bump prerelease counter, push, verify publish.yml publishes 0.2.19-next.N to npm for all 5 packages.

BEHAVIORS TO PRESERVE: existing README structure; release:next semantics (plugin not bumped on next).

DEPENDENCIES: P001, P002, P003 complete.
